lines.D: There's a light past the river nobody's been back from. Want it?
lines.C: I mapped three new gates. One's ugly. You'll love it.
lines.B: Something's walking around the old ruins at night. I didn't stay to ask.
lines.A: The sky platforms are humming. They never hum.
lines.S: I followed you to the Well once. Just to the edge. That's as far as I go.
lines.SOVEREIGN: Draw me a map of the bottom someday? I'll frame it.
